_about: Break Up With Renting: everything that changes during the program lives here. Leave a value as null until it exists; the site shows 'Coming soon' instead. After editing, the site rebuilds when the change is pushed.

lenderHook.title: Every lender looks at four things.
lenderHook.text: We'll walk you through each one, then show you your real number.

_sessions_note: The four sessions, one for each thing every lender looks at. Session names are drafts until Sherri and Robin confirm them.

sessions.name: Stack Your Down Payment
sessions.question: Do you have the money to put down?

sessions.name: Know Your Number
sessions.question: What can you afford, and what are you buying?

_session1Tips_note: One card per Session 1 message from Robin. Cards unlock on their own on releaseDate (Calgary time). Paste an unlisted YouTube link (vertical video) into videoUrl; leave it empty to show 'Video coming soon'. Add ?preview=all to the members hub address to see every card early.

session1Tips.title: Your credit is your reputation
bullets: Pay on time, even the minimum. Set up autopay.
Keep card balances under about 30% of the limit. Lower is better.
Aim for a score of 660 or higher.

session1Tips.title: Read your report like a lender
bullets: Compare your balances to your limits.
Look for anything that isn't yours, and dispute it for free.

session1Tips.title: Your first budget, the 10-minute version
bullets: Write down what actually came in last month.
Drop every charge into the tracker.

session1Tips.title: Debt triage: what to pay first
bullets: Anything late or in collections goes first.
Minimums on everything else, always on time.

graduation.label: Graduation
graduation.text: A Zoom celebration with an in-person option, ending with your pre-approval invite.

_liveQA_note: Fill in date as YYYY-MM-DD and time/endTime as Calgary time, e.g. "19:00". Until a date is set, the week shows with 'Exact day and time coming soon'. The members hub shows the next Q&A whose day or week hasn't ended yet, plus graduation as its own highlighted event, and offers an 'Add to calendar' file once the date, time and Zoom link are all set.

videos._note: Paste the YouTube link (unlisted is fine for members videos). null shows 'Video coming soon'.

downloads._note: Templates and scripts for Sessions 2 to 4. Add a url when each one is ready. Files put on this site are public if someone has the exact link, so use Google Drive links shared with 'anyone with the link' or ask for them to be added to the members area. neededBy is when each session's tools should be ready.
